Just after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] regrouped in the '''Pothor system''' in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was there that the Rebels were scheduled to meet with [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and two prototype [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] after the [[Battle of Roche (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Roche]]. It was intended that upon Ackbar's arrival to the Pothor system, he was to be promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]].<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1990]] ''[[Voyages SF 13|Voyages SF #13]]'' article "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]", which was published without [[Lucas Licensing]] and is thus non-canon, lists a "Togor" system attributed to ''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]'', of which appearances "Pothor system" is the closest match. As the ''Voyages SF'' article had already placed the [[Thanos system]] (in which the planet [[Togoria system|Togoria]] was already canonically placed) in the erroneously spelled, "[[Tau Sekar sector]]", prior to the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'' definitively placing Thanos system in the [[Taldot sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the "Togor" mention in ''[[Voyages SF 13|Voyages SF #13]]'' is assumed to be an erroroneous listing of "Pothor".<ref name="VSF13">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref>
